extracted.name: Creamy Pimento Cheese
extracted.description: This creamy pimento cheese is made with cream cheese, Cheddar, mayonnaise, and garlic powder. It is delicious spread on crackers or in a sandwich.
instruction_lines: Beat cream cheese in a large bowl with an electric mixer on medium speed until creamy. Add cheese and mix until light and fluffy. Beat in mayonnaise and garlic powder; stir in pimentos until incorporated. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
